screen_disposition: INCLUDED_SOURCE_DATASET; raw-source pair is descriptive only

primary_or_recognized_source: Saklar S; Ertas E; Ozdemir IS; Karadeniz B. Effects of different brewing conditions on catechin content and sensory acceptance in Turkish green tea infusions. Journal of Food Science and Technology 52(10):6639-6646 (2015).

exact_gate_or_exclusion_reason: Phase1B USDA NDB 99069 is decaffeinated tea standardized to 1g/100mL boiling water, N=2 aggregate, and cites an unpublished 2002 source with no source-level method. No source-matched standardized brew comparison is justified.

primary_or_recognized_source: Celik H; Ariburnu E; Baymak MS; Yesilada E. A rapid validated HPLC method for determination of sulforaphane and glucoraphanin in broccoli and red cabbage prepared by various cooking techniques. Analytical Methods 6:4559-4566 (2014).

exact_gate_or_exclusion_reason: The StageC record is an operational hydrolysis-released sulforaphane yield from lyophilized Beneforté broccoli on a dry-weight basis, including standardized analytical myrosinase hydrolysis.
